title: neottia convallarioides f. trifolia
intro: Neottia convallarioides f. trifolia, commonly known as the trifoliate orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid found in the mountainous regions of China. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Neottia convallarioides f. trifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional Chinese medicine.
